dimensions.assessment: Affects veterans utilizing Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits who are pursuing degrees in STEM or health care fields.
dimensions.evidence: allow individuals who are entitled to Post-9/11 GI Bill educational assistance and are pursuing eligible degrees... to receive up to nine additional months of benefits

dimensions.assessment: Reduces credit completion thresholds by 25% and removes remaining entitlement limits to qualify for up to $30,000 in additional education benefits.
dimensions.evidence: reduces by 25% the number of credits an individual must have completed in order to be eligible for the scholarship

dimensions.assessment: Expands access to federal scholarship funds capped at $30,000 per recipient, though total fiscal cost amounts are not stated.
dimensions.evidence: receive up to nine additional months of benefits (capped at $30,000)

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 38 of the United States Code regarding veterans' educational assistance eligibility and pension payment limits.
dimensions.evidence: amend title 38, United States Code, to modify the requirements of the Edith Nourse Rogers STEM Scholarship

dimensions.assessment: Permanent changes to scholarship eligibility criteria, along with a pension limitation extension through March 31, 2033.

missing_information: Total projected federal budget cost for the expanded scholarship eligibility
Exact number of additional veterans who will qualify
importance_detail.rationale: The bill expands eligibility for the Edith Nourse Rogers STEM Scholarship by easing credit and benefit-use requirements and extends a pension payment limitation date.
